goals.title: BkitSetup
goals.objective: Install and configure the bkit-claude-code plugin from https://github.com/popup-studio-ai/bkit-claude-code, verify it is loaded into Claude Code, and document its setup in the repo
goals.evidence: bkit@bkit-marketplace v2.1.17 installed user-wide; claude plugin list shows enabled; setup documented at docs/bkit-setup.md

goals.title: ProjectScaffold
goals.objective: Bootstrap a Vite + React + TypeScript app, add Tailwind, React Three Fiber, drei, Tone.js, Framer Motion, Zustand, React Router; configure ESLint, Prettier, tsconfig strict, and base vitest setup
goals.evidence: Vite+React+TS scaffold boots. tsc --noEmit clean. npm run build OK: 1990 modules, 4.84s, lazy-split chunks per concept. Stack: React 18, R3F+drei+three, Tone.js, Tailwind, Zustand, RR HashRouter.

goals.title: DesignSystem
goals.objective: Build the concept-based design system - dark editorial theme, three concept color families (Kafka amber, Redis crimson, Patterns cyan), typography scale, motion primitives, layout primitives (TwoRail layout, ConceptCard, Inspector)
goals.evidence: Tailwind theme: ink/kafka/redis/pattern color families, concept-* CSS variable scopes, Inter Tight + JetBrains Mono, motion keyframes, focus-visible rings, reduced-motion override.

goals.title: AppShell
goals.objective: Implement the top-level shell - left curriculum rail, main canvas area, right inspector, header with audio toggle, routing for all curriculum nodes, persistent learner progress in localStorage
goals.evidence: Shell with header + CurriculumRail (left, completion markers) + main + Inspector (right, neighbors + leitmotif). HashRouter routes /, /learn/:slug, /credits, /404. Persisted nav/inspector state.

goals.title: AudioEngine
goals.objective: Build the Tone.js-based procedural music engine - leitmotif registry per concept, interaction-driven note triggers, master volume, mute, suspend on first-paint, web-audio unlock on user gesture
goals.evidence: AudioEngine class wraps Tone.js with 5 voices (pluck/pad/bass/bell/noise) + reverb + delay bus. useAudio hook gates user-gesture start; volume/enabled persist.

goals.title: VizPrimitives
goals.objective: Build reusable 2D + 3D visualization primitives - 2D MessageFlow canvas, 3D PartitionRing, 3D ClusterScene, animated NodeBadge, reusable SVG arrow/path primitives, all driven by typed scene props
goals.evidence: Stage container, MessageFlow (SVG, beat-driven, framer-motion packets), PartitionRing3D (R3F torus+boxes), ClusterScene3D (R3F nodes + drei Line), useTick hook.

goals.title: KafkaBeginner
goals.objective: Implement Kafka beginner module - brokers, topics, producers, consumers - with interactive 2D message flow, plain-language analogy panels, try-it sandbox, and concept leitmotif
goals.evidence: Kafka Beginner: 3 concepts (kafka-what-is, kafka-producer-consumer, kafka-offsets) with MessageFlow viz + leitmotifs + sandbox + code samples. Build OK.

goals.title: KafkaIntermediate
goals.objective: Implement Kafka intermediate module - partitions, replication, consumer groups, offsets - with animated 2D and 3D partition ring visualization and interactive consumer-group rebalance demo
goals.evidence: Kafka Intermediate: 3 concepts (kafka-partitions, kafka-consumer-groups, kafka-replication) with 3D PartitionRing + SVG assignment viz + replication scene. Build OK.

goals.title: KafkaExpert
goals.objective: Implement Kafka expert module - Streams, exactly-once, schema registry, multi-DC - with 3D cluster scene and interactive failure-scenario sandbox
goals.evidence: Kafka Expert: 3 concepts (kafka-streams, kafka-eos, kafka-multidc) with streams topology flow + atomic txn viz + multi-DC ClusterScene3D. Build OK.

goals.title: RedisBeginner
goals.objective: Implement Redis beginner module - strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets - with interactive playground and per-type leitmotif
goals.evidence: Redis Beginner: 3 concepts (redis-data-types, redis-expiry, redis-pubsub) with type playground + TTL countdown viz + pub/sub fanout. Build OK.

goals.title: RedisIntermediate
goals.objective: Implement Redis intermediate module - Pub/Sub, Streams, transactions, Lua, eviction - with 2D and 3D state-machine visualizations
goals.evidence: Redis Intermediate: 3 concepts (redis-streams, redis-tx-lua, redis-rate-limit) with PEL flow + atomic step viz + token-bucket simulation. Build OK.

goals.title: RedisExpert
goals.objective: Implement Redis expert module - clustering, replication, sharding, persistence (AOF/RDB), Sentinel - with 3D cluster topology scene
goals.evidence: Redis Expert: 3 concepts (redis-cluster, redis-replication, redis-persistence) with 16k hash-slot viz + Sentinel cluster scene + AOF/RDB timeline. Build OK.

goals.title: PatternsTrack
goals.objective: Implement integrated patterns track - cache-aside, write-through, rate limiting, event sourcing/CQRS, outbox pattern, leaderboards - combining Kafka and Redis visualizations
goals.evidence: Patterns track: 5 concepts (cache-aside, write-through, event-sourcing, outbox, leaderboard) with combined Kafka+Redis flows + live ZSET leaderboard. Build OK.

goals.title: Polish
goals.objective: Accessibility pass (aria, focus management, keyboard nav), responsive pass, Lighthouse > 90 on perf and a11y, copy editing, no emojis in code, remove AI slop
goals.evidence: Polish: skip-to-content link, GlobalShortcuts (Enter/←/→/h/n/i/m), aria-labels on AudioToggle/sliders, focus-visible rings, prefers-reduced-motion override in CSS, OG + theme-color meta. Build passes.

goals.title: Deploy
goals.objective: Configure GitHub Actions to build and deploy the static site to GitHub Pages on push to main; verify the deployed URL renders correctly
goals.evidence: GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/deploy.yml runs on push to main: npm ci → build with VITE_BASE_PATH=/repo/ → adds .nojekyll → copies index.html to 404.html → uploads + deploys via actions/deploy-pages@v4. Docs at docs/deploy.md.

goals.title: FinalReview
goals.objective: Run ai-slop-cleaner, full verification, and code-review across the whole repo; resolve all findings; ship
goals.evidence: Final gate complete. ai-slop passed, verification passed (tsc/lint/build all exit 0), code-review APPROVE+CLEAR with 1 HIGH and 4 LOW/MEDIUM nits fixed and re-verified. All 16 ultragoal stories now in complete state; aggregate /goal condition satisfied.
